units.source_text: 苗子来到自己的家门前。

en.t: Naeko came to the front of her own house.

units.source_text: 与其说是家，不如说是个小窝棚。

en.t: Rather than a house, it was more like a little hut.

units.source_text: 年久失修的稻草屋顶，已经变得歪歪斜斜。

en.t: The straw roof, long neglected and unrepaired, had already grown crooked and lopsided.

units.source_text: 只因为是山间房子，所以还有个小院落。

en.t: Only because it was a house in the mountains did it still have a small yard.

units.source_text: 院落里的野生南天竹，结着红色的果实。

en.t: The wild nandina in the yard was bearing red berries.

units.source_text: 就是那么七八棵，也长得杂乱无章。

en.t: There were only seven or eight of them, but even so they grew in a disorderly tangle.
